tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Say It First is a supportive, low-stakes conversational practice stage for practicing difficult conversations safely with AI.

tour.title: Scenario & Domain Library
tour.description: Rich scenario definitions and partner archetypes configured in domain entities.

tour.title: Avatar & Practice Stage
tour.description: Interactive practice stage rendering Sophia using Tavus conversational video interface (CVI) or HeyGen LiveAvatar fallback.

tour.title: Backend Avatar Session Negotiation
tour.description: Server route handler connecting Next.js with Tavus CVI and ElevenLabs.
